This is Nisarg from Collabera and  I have a position open where I am looking for Operations IT Infrastructure Engineer (End Point). Please let me know if you would be interested in hearing more about this opportunity. Below is a detailed job description for your reference.

Looking forward to talk with you.

Feel free to reach me at 973-859-5421.

Position: IT Infrastructure Engineer (End Point)
Length: 12 months
Location: St. Louis, MO, 63141

Description:
This is an exciting role with many opportunities to evaluate and implement cutting edge technologies in the end user computing and productivity space. The Employee Productivity Technology Platform team is currently seeking a candidate that can assess and deliver the standards, tools, configurations, processes, monitoring and reporting requirements to support our end user environment. We are currently in need of engineering expertise to enable these critical projects: Office 365, Windows 10 and new hardware configurations to our organization. We are looking for an experienced individual who can help us evaluate, configure and deploy these capabilities to improve the productivity of our end users. 
This role is a continuing role that will extend into the foreseeable future (24+ months) and has the possibility to convert to a direct hire. 
An ideal candidate for this role would have proven record of designing and delivering solutions in these desktop and productivity technologies: 
•    Microsoft’s Deployment Toolkit and User State Migration Tool
•    Windows 7/10 
•    Bitlocker and MBAM 
•    Microsoft Office 2016/ 365 
•    Office 365 tenant administration and troubleshooting 
•    PowerShell 
•    JAMF/Casper 
•    Group Policy 
•    Windows Server Update Services 
•    Internet Explorer and Chrome Browser 
•    Lenovo’s Image Ultra Builder 
•    Industry/vendor certifications including: 
•    MCSA: Windows 7/10 
•    MCSE: Desktop Infrastructure certification 
•    MCSA: Office 365 
•    MOS: Expert Office 2013 
•    Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) 10.11 
•    Mac and PC Hardware

Regards,
